map.继承（遗嘱/公证/遗产）分配 使用指南: Inheritance (will / notarization / estate) Distribution User Guide
map.继承（遗嘱/公证/遗产）分配工具依据法定或遗嘱继承规则测算各继承人应得份额，提示: The inheritance (will / notarization / estate) distribution tool estimates each heir's share under intestate or testamentary rules and flags notarization and tax points, for estate planning and family discussion.
map.立遗嘱人按意愿分配遗产，工具辅助测算各继承人依遗嘱或法定应得份额。: The testator distributes the estate by intention, and the tool helps estimate each heir's share under the will or by law.
map.办理继承公证前，先理清遗产范围与继承人清单。: Before arranging inheritance notarization, clarify the estate scope and the list of heirs.
map.对比遗嘱继承与法定继承的份额差异。: Compare the share differences between testate and intestate succession.
map.：遗产 500 万元，遗嘱指定配偶 300 万、子女 200 万，工具据此生成分: : estate 5,000,000, with a will specifying 3,000,000 to the spouse and 2,000,000 to the children; the tool generates the distribution list from this; with no will it is divided equally by law.
map.：同一 500 万遗产，法定由 4 名第一顺序继承人各得 125 万；遗嘱可打破: : for the same 5,000,000 estate, intestate succession gives 4 first-order heirs 1,250,000 each; a will can break equal division but must reserve a necessary share for heirs who lack the ability to work and have no source of income.
map.遗嘱一定要公证才有效吗？: Must a will be notarized to be valid?
map.不一定，自书、代书、打印、录音录像、口头（危急情况）遗嘱均可能有效，但公证遗嘱证: Not necessarily; holographic, dictated, printed, audio-visual and oral (in emergencies) wills can all be valid, but a notarized will carries stronger evidentiary weight; an oral will lapses once the emergency passes.
map.哪些人必须保留份额？: Who must keep a reserved share?
map.缺乏劳动能力又没有生活来源的继承人应保留必要遗产份额，该保留不受遗嘱其他安排削减: An heir who lacks the ability to work and has no source of income must keep a necessary share of the estate, and that reserved share is not reduced by other provisions of the will.
